summary: Frontend-only e2e at 360x780 (Playwright, 6 browser runs) covering features C (Rival Level slider), D (move visual overrides) and E (Evolution Items: drops, Bag in battle, roster Use button), plus regressions. All core flows work. No console errors or pageerrors in any run. Rival slider: values exactly as spec (power 466, budgets 373/419/466/513/559/606, slot N/6); tick buttons, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and reload persistence all work. Battle seed 777: L1 NPC [Munchlax, Rhyhorn, Anorith, Ponyta, Farfetch'd, Mawile] avg BST ~372, meta.slot 1. L6 NPC [Ursaring, Snorlax, Tauros, Lucario, Aerodactyl, Scyther] avg BST ~512, meta.slot 6. __visualCoverage: 265 damaging moves, 0 fallback (burst=0), pulse=7 (includes psychic and confusion), beam includes thunderbolt; none of the 9 named moves are in fallback. The Alakazam battle (seed 9001) rendered effects (__fxCount 13 at t540, canvas not blank) and ended phase 'ended' with the player winning at tick 8567; this is a different order from iteration_6's 7608 team, so that is expected. No drop on that quick win. Roster Use Thunder Stone: toast 'Pikachu evolved into Raichu!', unlocked [26], thunder-stone key deleted, Raichu card unlocked. Vaporeon: enabled 'Use Water Stone', In bag 2. Jolteon: disabled 'No Thunder Stone yet'. Poliwrath: disabled, with item-progress 'unlock its earlier form first'. Mid-battle Bag: badge 1, bag pauses the tick (204→204), shows 'In bag ×1' with Raichu BST 485. Using it gives unit0 creatureId 26, HUD shows Raichu, evolved.length 1, inputLog {type:'item', itemId:'thunder-stone'}, save.items {}, unlocked [26]. The battle resumes, and pause and 1x/4x speed work (59 vs 240 ticks/s). Gauntlet stage 1 win produced a guaranteed drop: result-item-drop data-item='kings-rock', save.items {'kings-rock':1}. Replay (/replay#… from Share) renders with data-mode=replay and 0 bag-button. Export JSON includes items and rivalLevel, and re-import with items/rivalLevel restores them correctly. Forced pick TeamStrip appears on faint and a pick resumes play. The result screen with credit breakdown renders and the top is no longer clipped.

ui_bugs.issue: The spec says re-opening Raichu after unlocking should show item-progress 'already in your roster'. Instead the whole unlock-panel-item is absent: CreatureDetailSheet only renders <UnlockPanel> when `locked`, so the `owned` branch in UnlockPanel is dead code. Functionally OK because there is no use button, but the spec text never shows.

For Poliwrath, while Poliwhirl is still locked, the disabled button still reads 'Use Water Stone' when the player has the stone. The button should say e.g. 'Unlock Poliwhirl first'. The reason only appears in the small item-progress text.

When the active unit has no item evolution (Raichu after evolving, Charizard), bag-button is disabled. So BagSheet's 'bag-empty' state ('X has no item evolution.') can never be reached from the UI. Either keep the button openable to show bag-empty, or remove the dead state. The spec expected opening it to show bag-empty.

prettyName(slug) turns 'kings-rock' into 'Kings Rock' (missing apostrophe). It appears in the result drop 'Found Kings Rock', the Save bag panel and the roster sheet. Add a name override for kings-rock (King's Rock), plus similar ones like 'deep-sea-tooth' and 'dubious-disc' if needed.

integration_issues.issue: validateSave/normalizeSave do not sanitize the new fields. Importing a file with rivalLevel 99 and items {'thunder-stone':-5,'fake-item':2} succeeds and persists those raw values to localStorage. The UI clamps rivalLevel via clampLevel and bagCount<=0 disables use, but the bag panel/total can show negative or unknown items. Clamp rivalLevel in normalizeSave, and filter items to positive integers whose id is in the catalog (or at least positive integers).

issues: The sonner success toast renders at the top and covers the opponent HUD (name/HP bar) for several seconds. Consider bottom-center placement or a shorter duration on /battle.
The floating 'PIKACHU → RAICHU' banner is clipped or hidden behind the right-side speed/pause control column.
The item name truncates to 'Thun...' because the sprite pair and the fixed w-20 target column take up the row. Let the name wrap, or put the name on its own line.
Tick buttons 1–6 are 9px text-slate-600 on a slate-900 background: low contrast, and the touch targets are tiny (well under 44px).
With npcIds override the HUD shows 'CHAMPION · LV.2'. 'Champion' is both an AI archetype name and the Lv.6 rival level name, so a Lv.2 rival labelled 'Champion' is confusing.

action_items: Sanitize imported/loaded save: clamp rivalLevel to 1..6 and drop non-positive or unknown item entries in normalizeSave.

Decide on the bag-empty state: either allow opening the Bag when bagOptions=0 (to show 'X has no item evolution.') or remove the dead code. Likewise either render UnlockPanel for owned item-evolutions ('already in your roster') or remove that branch.
Poliwrath-style case: change the disabled button label to say the earlier form must be unlocked first.
Fix item names that need an apostrophe (kings-rock → King's Rock).
Minor polish: BagSheet name truncation, toast covering the opponent HUD in battle, evolution banner clipped by the speed column, rival tick button contrast/size.

Optional balance note: __rivalTest shows rival avg BST plateauing at L4–L6 (527/527/529 against budgets 513/559/606, 113–114% of power) because the pool runs out. L5 and L6 differ little from L4. In the live seed-777 battle, L6 avg was ~512 against a budget of 606.
critical_code_review_comments: BattlePage evolution persistence effect runs on every snapshot and loops over state.evolved; OK since evolved is tiny, but the toast is only shown when applyEvolutionItem succeeds. If the save no longer has the item (e.g. consumed in another tab), the engine has already evolved the unit with no item consumed, and there is no error toast. Consider validating bagCount before pushing the item input (useItem) as a guard.
rivalTest L1 avg BST 408 at budget 373 (109%), so the L1 rival can exceed the stated ~80% budget. In the live battle, L1 averaged ~372, which is fine.

success_rate.frontend: ~95%. All 10 requested areas pass functionally; 2 spec text expectations (owned 'already in your roster' and bag-empty reachable) are unmet by design, plus 1 import-sanitization gap.

seed_data_creation: Per browser context, localStorage arenadex.save.v1 was seeded via add_init_script guarded with if(!getItem). window.__battleOverride was set from sessionStorage 'ovr' in the init script, so it can be changed between page.goto calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dex syncs quickly now (cached). Gauntlet start button navigates straight to /battle?mode=gauntlet; there is no separate fight click on the first stage. Seed 4242 with player [25,133,6,94,143,130] vs [1,4,7,10,13,16] on pitch with autoPick:false: forced TeamStrip appears at about t1560 at 4x. The Alakazam-led 9001 battle ([65,25,6,94,143,130] vs [65,64,63,96,97,124], cavern) ends with a player win at t8567 and no drop. A gauntlet stage-1 win with team [6,94,143,130,65,59] dropped kings-rock (random seed). For Share in headless mode, stub navigator.share=undefined and navigator.clipboard.writeText to capture the replay URL.
